title: operator fencing caused cascading tenant reconcile delays; staged hotfix and staggered redeploy plan
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Summary: Multiple on-prem customers reported prolonged tenant upgrade stalls after control-plane operator fencing events. Symptoms: operator enters short-lived fence state, leader election flips rapidly, tenant controllers delay reconciles for 10+ minutes leading to customer application errors and upgrade timeouts. Impacted modes: Private (VPC) and on-prem deployments using helm-managed operator. This ticket tracks triage, an emergency hotfix branch, rollout plan, and post-deploy verification.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Priya Natarajan: Escalation from two enterprise customers (support cases #C-1842, #C-1849). Observed upgrade pipeline timeouts and repeated helm hooks failing during post-upgrade reconcile. Opening investigation. Triage: mark P0 and convene on-call.

2026-03-02 - Alex Carter: Reproduced locally with k8s v1.25 + operator v1.12. Operator leader election loop observed when CRD apply rate spikes during tenant rehydrate. Found race between helm-hook finalizers and operator's in-memory queue drain; fence flag set but not cleared under heavy reconciler backlog.

2026-03-03 - Mei Chen (SRE): Added temporary mitigation: increase reconcile backoff and disable aggressive leader-restart in daemon config for affected clusters; communicated runbook to SEs for immediate mitigation steps. Reduced customer impact for 2 of 3 clusters.

2026-03-04 - Alex Carter: Implemented fix in branch fix/operator-fence-stable-730219: ensure fence state persisted to CR status with TTL, serializes helm-hook finalizer processing, and adds guard to prevent concurrent fence resets when queue depth > threshold. Benchmarked locally: reduce leader-election churn by ~95% under synthetic load.

2026-03-05 - Designated QA (Jordan Lee): Stress tests with 500 concurrent helm-hook apply events: operator remains stable, reconciler backlog drains without flipping leader repeatedly. No new memory regressions observed.

2026-03-06 - Priya Natarajan: Customer-facing mitigation applied to Escalated accounts: staged config change + manual restart window. Informed customers of hotfix availability and proposed staggered rollout to avoid broad blast radius.

2026-03-07 - Release Manager (Samira Ortiz): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/1826. Patch includes migration to persisted fence status and a feature-flag gated rollout. Preparing release notes and rollback plan. Marking this ticket In Review ahead of production rollout on 2026-03-09.

2026-03-07 - Alex Carter: Added automated detection: alert rule operator.fence.churn_rate > 0.05 triggers runbook and throttles helm-hook parallelism. Creating a Grafana dashboard panel for immediate monitoring.
resolution_plan: 1) Merge fix branch behind feature flag. 2) Stage rollout to internal staging clusters for 24h smoke. 3) Enable feature flag for one low-impact customer cluster and monitor fence_churn, reconcile-latency, leader-election-count for 6h. 4) If metrics stable, proceed with staggered 25%/50%/100% rollouts across affected customers over 48h with rollback window. 5) If instability detected, flip feature flag off and revert to previous operator image while executing remediation runbook.
follow_up_tasks: Create permanent operator metric for fence-state TTL expirations
Add integration test to GH actions that simulates concurrent helm-hook + operator reconcile flows
Audit other code paths that set fence state to ensure idempotency
Document rollback playbook and share with Solutions Engineering
Postmortem within 7 days and update customer communication templates
